profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer, Data Management, AI architecture (RAG).
profile.jobTitle: Sr. Software Developer and AI Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in AI-RAG (Enterprise/DoD Application), Azure AI Foundry, C# (.net and core), VB, Java, HTML, JQuery, JavaScript, Internet Information Services (IIS), ArcGIS map, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Azure cloud, SQL and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS). Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused on Information Technology/Software Engineering from the University of Phoenix.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer and AI Engineer
positions.description:
Custom AI RAG Model and UI:
* Requirements Gathering & Planning (permission and user stories)
* Data Collection & Preprocessing (RAG)
* Model Development (fine-tuning local and Azure RAG)
* System Integration & Testing
* UI/UX Development (C# or Blazor)
* Deployment & Scalability (Azure)
* User Testing & Feedback (UAT)
* Documentation & Training
* Maintenance & Continuous Improvement (CI/CD pipeline)
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Blazor · C# · Python (Programming Language) · Bash · Docker Products · Microsoft Azure · Azure SQL · Microsoft Azure Machine Learning · Azure Databricks · Azure DevOps Services · Terraform
